definitions.explanation: A Buddhist name given by a priest to a person who has died, written on the memorial tablet ({位牌|いはい}) and the grave. Longer, higher-ranking names require a larger donation to the temple, which is a common topic of complaint.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住職|じゅうしょく}→住職：15520_juushoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{戒名|かいみょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけて⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: To have the head priest give a posthumous name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{位牌|いはい}→位牌：07132_ihai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{戒名|かいみょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather's posthumous name is written on the memorial tablet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{戒名|かいみょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{俗名|ぞくみょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Lately more people hold funerals under the person's ordinary name, without a posthumous name.

notes:
Originally the name a person received on taking Buddhist precepts ({戒|かい}); in Japan it is now given almost only after death. The Jōdo Shinshū sect calls it {法名|ほうみょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戒名|かいみょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける: to give a posthumous name
- {戒名|かいみょう}⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧: the fee for a posthumous name
- {院号|いんごう}: the prestigious 〜{院|いん} element of a long posthumous name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {俗名|ぞくみょう}: the name a person used in life
